text:
Maria: Quick sync — finalizing GA acceptance checklist for the Dedicated V1 launch in two weeks. Need clear owners for: SLA/SLOs, docs/playbooks, support/oncall, monitoring/alerts, pricing & billing. Who's got what?

Ben: I can own SLA definitions and rollout plan. Proposal: SLO 99.9% + p95 latency < 200ms for small payloads. Can we compromise on latency tiers?

Sara: @Ben ok. From SRE side we need error budget policy + runbook. Also want warmup canaries and automated fallback to smaller model. My draft:
```
SLOs:
 - Availability: 99.9% monthly
 - Error budget: 0.1% per month
 - Latency (p95): <= 200ms for <=1k tokens
Oncall: infra oncall primary, eng-runtime secondary
```

Alex: Pricing note — we need tiered pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated. Proposal: Hosted per-token + discounted reserved rate for Dedicated. Also add a "pilot" flat fee for first 3 months.

Kyle: Docs owner here. I'll draft: Quickstart, GA release notes, SLA summary page, rollback/playbook. Need examples and sample alerts. Will link PR by EOD Wed.

Jess: Support readiness: training doc + triage cheatsheet + escalation matrix. Also confirm hours for coverage (standard: 24/7 for enterprise). Who confirms SLAs with sales?

Maria: I'll confirm with Sales. Also we need monitoring dash: model quality metrics + regressions alerts. @Ben @Sara can you two give list of metrics by EOD Monday?

Ben: Will send metric list (latency, throughput, tail latency, rejected requests, model mismatch rate) and proposed thresholds.

Sara: Adding SLO burn alert + perf regression alert. Need ops runbook for cold-start spikes.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on error budget breach. See /deploys/2799.

Maria: Action items summarized:
- Ben: SLA doc + metrics (owner)
- Sara: Ops runbook + canary playbook
- Kyle: Docs + release notes
- Jess: Support training + escalation
- Alex: Finalize pricing tiers
I'll run a short review Thurs 10:30am. :thumbsup:

Ben: :thumbsup: will have SLA draft by Wed.
Kyle: I'll put the doc in the repo and ping here when PRs ready.
Jess: Training slot needed — propose Wed 4pm.
Alex: OK to align pricing with committed capacity by Thurs.

Maria: Cool. If anyone hits blockers ping me. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
